research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Netskope is researching and developing systems for real-time security, data protection, and network management, as shown by innovations such as data loss prevention of enterprise information stored on cloud computing services, simulation and visualization of malware spread through sharing of data objects, cloud security distributed architecture, and machine learning powered cloud sandbox for malware detection. These efforts focus on cloud security, threat detection, and data loss prevention.

overview_description.description: Netskope links users to the internet, any application, and their infrastructure from any device, on or off the network, in a secure and fast manner. Unlike competitors who force security and networking choices, their global security private cloud offers complete computation capabilities at the edge. It's fast everywhere, data-driven, and cloud-savvy, all while promoting good digital citizenship and lowering the total cost of ownership.

about_short_description.short_description: Netskope is an IT firm that specializes in real-time security, stopping threats, protecting data, and network management services.

product.name: Netskope One Platform
product.description: A cloud-native platform that integrates security and networking services to provide fast, secure access to AI, cloud, and web applications.

product.name: Zero Trust Engine
product.description: A core engine that enforces continuous adaptive trust-based policies across multiple security services to prevent security gaps.

product.name: Netskope One Client
product.description: A unified client that provides remote user access to web, cloud, and private applications with integrated endpoint security features.

product.name: Netskope One Gateway
product.description: A hardware and virtual gateway that consolidates multiple network and security functions into a unified SASE gateway for diverse deployment environments.

product.name: Netskope NewEdge Network
product.description: A private security cloud and network backbone that optimizes connectivity and processing for the Netskope One platform.

product.name: Netskope One Console
product.description: A cloud-based management console that provides unified policy management for security and networking services across distributed environments.
